# ENCE - Naive vs Warmstart vs Active-Set Beta Diagnostic

## Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
tag          <- "Implementations_Sweep_with_betas"
results_file <- sprintf("section_4_2_implementations_sweep_betas_%s.rds", tag)

betas_run <- readRDS(results_file)

cutoff_tag <- round(betas_run$meta$cutoff * 100)
naive_betas     <- read.csv(sprintf("betas_naive_history_cutoff%d.csv", cutoff_tag))
warmstart_betas <- read.csv(sprintf("betas_warmstart_history_cutoff%d.csv", cutoff_tag))
active_betas    <- read.csv(sprintf("betas_active_history_cutoff%d.csv", cutoff_tag))
```

## Run Identification

```{r meta, results='hold'}
meta <- betas_run$meta
cat("description:", meta$description, "\n")
cat("run_time:   ", format(meta$run_time), "\n")
cat("hostname:   ", meta$hostname, " job:", meta$slurm_job_id,
    " nodelist:", meta$slurm_nodelist, "\n")
cat("R version:  ", meta$r_version, "\n")
cat("cutoff:", meta$cutoff, " mask_frac:", meta$mask_frac, " mask_seed:", meta$mask_seed, "\n")
cat("n_stations:", meta$n_stations, " n_observed:", meta$n_observed, " n_masked:", meta$n_masked, "\n")
cat("years:", paste(range(meta$years), collapse = "-"), "\n\n")
```

## Beta CSVs

```{r beta_structure, results='hold'}
cat("naive_betas:     ", nrow(naive_betas),     "rows,", length(unique(naive_betas$cycle)),     "cycles\n")
cat("warmstart_betas: ", nrow(warmstart_betas), "rows,", length(unique(warmstart_betas$cycle)), "cycles\n")
cat("active_betas:    ", nrow(active_betas),    "rows,", length(unique(active_betas$cycle)),    "cycles\n\n")

str(naive_betas)
```

```{r beta_head, results='hold'}
cat("naive_betas head:\n");     print(head(naive_betas, 10))
cat("\nwarmstart_betas head:\n"); print(head(warmstart_betas, 10))
cat("\nactive_betas head:\n");    print(head(active_betas, 10))
```

```{r beta_summary, results='hold'}
cat("naive beta value summary:\n");     print(summary(naive_betas$beta))
cat("\nwarmstart beta value summary:\n"); print(summary(warmstart_betas$beta))
cat("\nactive beta value summary:\n");    print(summary(active_betas$beta))
```

```{r active_set_size, results='hold'}
nonzero_by_cycle <- function(df) {
  agg <- aggregate(beta ~ cycle, data = df, FUN = function(b) sum(b != 0))
  setNames(agg$beta, agg$cycle)
}

cat("Nonzero beta count per cycle, naive:\n");     print(nonzero_by_cycle(naive_betas))
cat("\nNonzero beta count per cycle, warmstart:\n"); print(nonzero_by_cycle(warmstart_betas))
cat("\nNonzero beta count per cycle, active-set:\n"); print(nonzero_by_cycle(active_betas))
```
